provenance: New ScreenCaptureKit recordings of the real Tauri app running on the Mac mini through testq + minijob.
UI language and fictional demo mailbox use the locale catalog. Dark graphite theme; fresh profile per locale.
The capture build enables webdriver; the harness hides the sidebar version and button focus rings. No app UI is redrawn.

Search is prepared with a local archive and cut between query entry and results. Backup destination is a write-tested temporary folder, not a physical external drive; setup is off camera, and longer waits may be cut.

Images and posters are decoded from these new raw recordings at a representative moment; the manifest records the source time and crop. Search stills retain the query panel alongside the results. MP4s use the feature-card crops and trims from those same recordings. A version/locale footer is added below the UI.
The Mac mini display was temporarily switched to its existing 2x mode before recording; the adjustment log is retained with the evidence.

How-to recordings (bulk-* and settings-* archive and delete): ScreenCaptureKit takes of the real app on the Mac mini at 2x, one app launch per locale (UI language and demo mailbox from the locale catalog); stills are decoded at recorded step moments; a long progress wait is cut from the videos and captioned as shortened.

After-delete recordings (after-delete-*): ScreenCaptureKit takes of the real app on the Mac mini at 2x, one app launch per locale (UI language and demo mailbox from the locale catalog). Each take re-seeds read flags off camera and fails unless the reader opens the email the option promises. The camera zoom is cut from the same 2x frames, aimed at rectangles the take recorded; pointer, click ripple and version footer are the only added pixels.
